query:
SELECT s.tags AS "tags!",
               AVG(s.avg_viewers)::float8 AS avg_viewers,
               COUNT(*)::bigint AS "usage_count!"
        FROM twitch_stream_sessions s
        WHERE s.streamer_login = $1
          AND s.started_at >= $2
          AND s.tags IS NOT NULL
          AND s.tags != ''
        GROUP BY s.tags
        ORDER BY 2 DESC
